claim_one_line: THE RECOUNT: FIVE RESOURCES, AND THE RANK CLOSING IS UNSOURCED -- cc3's tau_vs_singlet correction verified on this bench and ADOPTED, with every load-bearing input already banked on main. SO B963'S TWO THEOREMS STAND AND ITS COROLLARY FALLS: 'tau is the only rank-reducing involution' is TRUE AND IRRELEVANT to a closing not effected by an involution -- a category slip, the same shape as the theta/theta_QCD and level/level hazards. PROPAGATED IN THE SAME COMMIT: B963 FINDINGS banner; LAW_MAP twice (the B963 row and B1000's sharing-one-resource clause); THE_CLAIM section 1 corrected 4 to 5 typed external data; THE_FRAMEWORK Layer 5; SM_SPECIFICATION_LEDGER; RETRACTED_PHRASES row 8 ('chirality and rank compete for one resource' and variants).
